section.title: Examples of Accessing the API
section.p: See Authenticate page to acquire a token.

sectiondiv.p: The following example shows how to use curl to Bulk-import orders from a CSV file.
The following example shows how to use Python to Bulk-import orders from a CSV file.
sectiondiv.codeblock: import requests import json headers = { "Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "text/csv", "Authorization": "<auth-token>" } with open("request.csv") as f: data = json.load(f) url = "https://" + SERVER_URL + "/api/v1/orders/import" resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=data)
